browser: Chromium (browser pane of the Claude desktop app), page served from a local HTTP server
scope: Targeted review of the language menu and of the screen in a real browser; messages, records and the choice of the start language are covered by interpreter-multilingual-tests.mjs.
checks: With browser languages ja and ja-JP and no saved choice, the screen started in Japanese.
Add Two Three was re-verified with 34 steps (δ 13 / β 21) and read as the Church numeral 5; the input λx. was recorded as an error before the start with the message 式が途中で終わっています。
Choosing Français in the menu switched the whole screen, including the computation history, to French and saved the choice; after a reload without a language parameter the screen was still in French.
The URL parameter lang=zh-Hant overrode the saved choice; the step-limit results of QRepInv QZero and (λx.x x) (λx.x x) and an error before the start were shown in Traditional Chinese.
In Russian, saving the history reported one trace and one error before the start.
At a width of 375 px, no element of the screen in any of the 11 languages extended beyond its panel, and the page did not scroll sideways.
limits: Opening the file directly from the disk (a file: URL) was not checked in this browser.
Loading a JSON file through the file dialog was not driven in the browser; loading, rejection of tampered traces and saving are checked with a simulated screen in interpreter-multilingual-tests.mjs.
Browser language settings other than ja were not set in the browser profile; the choice of the start language is checked in Node with given values.
This review does not certify every interface feature or any mathematical theorem.
